svg.title: Multi-record NDEF behaviour — how phones treat a bundle
svg.desc: Phone behaviour tiles for multi-record NDEF: iOS 14 and later handles multi-record tags natively and opens the first record by default; Android 8.1 and 9 behaviour is verified per record layout on the encoding bench before a bulk run ships.
svg.text: Bundles are powerful — phones have opinions
Multi-record NDEF works, provided the record order respects how handsets read
